verdict.rationale: Steel documents built-in Managed Residential Proxies plus Bring Your Own Proxy, and has a dedicated proxies and rotation docs page and a Dedicated IPs option. Its overview advertises managed cloud browsers with stealth, and a community comment confirms that custom proxies can be set. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of stealth fingerprinting controls (what is spoofed and how to enable it), evidence of geo-targeting or country selection for proxies, and independent hands-on corroboration that automations avoid bot blocking.
